routes.operator_command_template: powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $repo=$null; if(Get-Command sas -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue){$repo=(& sas repo 2>$null | Select-Object -First 1)}; if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$repo)){$cache=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'SysAdminSuite\repo-root.txt'; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $cache -PathType Leaf){$repo=(Get-Content -LiteralPath $cache -Raw).Trim()}}; if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$repo)){throw 'SysAdminSuite repo root is unresolved; run sas refresh on Guest/Internet first.'}; $repo=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath(([string]$repo).Trim()); $launcher=Join-Path $repo 'Run-AutoLogonCrashSafe.cmd'; if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $launcher -PathType Leaf)){throw ('Crash-safe AutoLogon launcher missing from resolved repo: '+$repo)}; Set-Location -LiteralPath $repo; & $launcher 'HOST'; exit $LASTEXITCODE"
routes.proof_ceiling: Proves only that the operator command resolves a repository location, selects the registered crash-safe front door, and propagates its exit code. Live deployment proof comes only from the field-run artifacts.
